name: cursor-echo
description: Analyzes your Cursor chat sessions, spots recurring friction patterns, and tells you which Cursor features to use to fix them.

cursorEcho.transcriptsPath.description: Custom path to a directory of .jsonl transcript files. Auto-discovers ~/.cursor/projects/ if empty.

cursorEcho.minTurns.description: Skip sessions shorter than this many turns.

cursorEcho.saveReport.description: Write .cursor/echo-report.md to the workspace after each run.

cursorEcho.aiMode.description: Echo Pro: opt in to AI-powered analysis using your own API key. Sends transcript text to your chosen provider. Disabled by default; falls back to local heuristics if no key is set.

enumDescriptions: OpenAI Chat Completions API (direct HTTPS, lightweight).
Cursor SDK (@cursor/sdk). Requires Node >= 22.13 in the extension host and the optional dependency to be installed.
cursorEcho.aiProvider.description: Echo Pro: which backend to use when AI mode is enabled.

cursorEcho.aiModel.description: Echo Pro: model id for the selected provider. Leave empty to use a sensible per-provider default.

cursorEcho.maxSessionsForAI.description: Echo Pro: cap how many of the most recent sessions are sent to the AI provider per run, to bound cost and latency.

cursorEcho.redactBeforeSend.description: Echo Pro: redact likely secrets (tokens, keys, emails) from transcript text before sending it to the AI provider.
